cuts.head: over_shoulder
cuts.ofreeRecent: a night observatory under an open dome — holds a book closed against her chest; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; holds one end of a towel hung around her neck; a night-train sleeper compartment with a narrow berth — holds a cup at chest height; an outdoor pool with lounge chairs and clear blue water — swimming breaststroke; a futuristic spa of white curves and soft light — standing; a starship galley and mess hall — dries her hair with a towel; a snowy mountain-lodge terrace with a wooden railing and benches above a winter valley — holds a smartphone up at arm's length to take a selfie; a circus tent ring under a striped canopy — sitting on the ground; inside a knightly order's campaign pavilion — sitting on the ground; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — standing; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — carries a small red paper lantern by its cord; a night observatory under an open dome — standing
